answer: Assume the operator is lazy and will run one image many times. Decay every edge that goes unused, cap attestations per identity per epoch, and require the quorum to span unrelated subnetworks. Then 200 copies of one image sit inside one subnetwork, collect one cap and face a quorum they cannot fill. The fable of cheap replication ends at the lagoon edge, and the ivory of their bond stays locked until the audit closes.
